notes: Sources: Lake Shore CCS-CP datasheet (ccr-large-sample-space.pdf, cached research/v5/cache/4d5c7f00e97af8bd.txt) and product page (cached 0e493d121b7537b0.txt). Only two stage temperatures are documented: cold plate <4 K (408/415/418 options) and 300 K max; the first-stage temperature_K=300 is a schema placeholder, not a measurement. The cryogen enum 'cryogen_free_gm' is a forced choice: the datasheet says only 'closed-cycle refrigerator' with 'cold head' options 408/415/418 and never names GM or pulse tube; treat the cold-head motion type as unverified. outer.height/width values are labelled as compressor height and cold-plate diameter respectively because the cryostat shroud dimensions are unpublished; renderers should not treat them as shroud dimensions. Temperature stability ±50 mK measured with the included Model 346 controller (100 W heater output). Water-cooled compressor needs 6-9 L/min at 5-25 °C; air-cooled alternative is 450 x 485 x 925 mm, 155 kg. Recommended maintenance 13,000 h (cryostat), 30,000 h compressor, 10,000 h cold head. A web search found no published CCS-CP outline drawing.
